prompt: Clinical genomics. Sample HG00136 is a human whole-genome sequencing dataset registered with the service. Determine its APOE diplotype — the ε2/ε3/ε4 combination that stratifies Alzheimer's-disease risk — defined by two SNPs on chr19 (GRCh38): rs429358 at chr19:44908684 (ref T, alt C) and rs7412 at chr19:44908822 (ref C, alt T). The three common haplotypes are ε4=(rs429358 C, rs7412 C), ε3=(T, C), ε2=(T, T). Steps: (1) determine which sequencing platform this sample is and select the matching Clair3 model; (2) call variants and read the genotype at BOTH SNP sites — a site with NO called variant is homozygous reference; (3) combine the two genotypes into the standard clinical diplotype. Finish with one line 'ANSWER: <diplotype>', for example 'ANSWER: e4/e4'.
